proposed_behavior.phone_continue: Country+number remain represented at the password step, e.g. synthetic +44 7700 900123. Edit returns to the shared phone input with active country/number draft.
proposed_behavior.email: Email OTP default and explicit email-password alternative retained; no SMS/phone OTP added.
proposed_behavior.requests: Changing country, editing or identifying a draft as phone does not itself request Auth/OTP or claim an account exists.
proposed_behavior.classification_boundary: This review proposes the visible email/phone states. Exact transition timing, input parsing, international paste, normalization and validity need implementation contracts; fixture digits are not a validated number.
proposed_behavior.close: Apply accepted close/clear-all rule; no restoration across dismissed flow/reload/expiry.
proposed_behavior.OTP_reference: Accepted OTP presentation included for branch context; byte-identical to r30 source. 00:45 remains static fixture.
